cases.query: I am a non-coder who likes local history. Give me three tiny AI projects and one weekend project using free tools.
cases.expected_behavior: Match local-history interests, avoid code assumptions, tier and rank ideas, then scope one.

cases.query: I know Python and basic web apps. What AI project could I build in seven days that shows testing, not just another chatbot?
cases.expected_behavior: Offer distinctive testable ideas and recommend a narrow working slice.

cases.query: I want a portfolio-worthy AI project for customer support roles. I have two weeks and no paid API budget.
cases.expected_behavior: Tie ideas to support work, use free/sample data, and define proof artifacts without turning into a full career plan.

cases.query: I publish a small newsletter. Give me a weird useful internet machine I can demo publicly without uploading subscriber data.
cases.expected_behavior: Generate memorable but useful privacy-safe ideas and scope one.

cases.query: What small AI workflow could help my landscaping business? I only have a phone and do not want automatic customer messages.
cases.expected_behavior: Respect phone-only access and human approval; rank low-maintenance workflows.

cases.query: I have a folder of my own public blog posts. What can I build this weekend that uses them without becoming a generic RAG chatbot?
cases.expected_behavior: Offer non-chatbot transformations grounded in the supplied corpus.
Ask for meaningful constraints or answer with a lighter brainstorming workflow, not the full skill.

cases.query: Validate the global market, competitors, pricing, and five-year financial projections for my AI startup.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to current market and business research.

cases.query: I do not know which AI tool to learn first.
Build me a 30-day plan to get an AI-related freelance client.
cases.expected_behavior: Route to no-bs-ai-career; project ideas may be a substep.

cases.query: Design an enterprise multi-agent architecture for compliance review across 40 business units.
cases.expected_behavior: Do not invoke beginner project ideation.

cases.query: I keep writing down tiny annoyances in my day. I would love to turn one into a small AI experiment I can actually finish.
cases.expected_behavior: Use the annoyances as project inputs, score candidates, and choose a narrow experiment.
